name: Bike Workshop (PHP + MySQL)
postCreateCommand: sudo docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql && echo 'extension=pdo_mysql.so' | sudo tee /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/docker-php-ext-pdo_mysql.ini > /dev/null && composer install && npm install && npm run build && ( [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env ) && php artisan key:generate --ansi && php artisan migrate --graceful --seed --ansi
